message: I'd like a quote on the T75 Row-Crop with front loader and delivery/setup. List totals $75,400; my budget is around $55,500. Can you get close to that?

Thanks for the interest in the T75 package. $55,500 is well below what I can do on a 75 hp cab tractor with a loader and on-site setup. I can take a meaningful amount off list, though: $72,400 for the T75 Row-Crop, front loader, and delivery/setup. If budget is the hard constraint, I'm also happy to quote the T45 Utility with a loader, which may fit closer to your number depending on your acreage.
Heartland posts the T75 at $65,950, loader $6,300, delivery $875. I need a 75 hp for 74 acres of haying, so the T45 won't do. I can do $60,000 for the T75 + loader + delivery today.

Thanks for the details. A 75 hp cab tractor is the right fit for haying 74 acres. I can't verify Heartland's pricing, but even taking those numbers as given, their package comes to about $73,125. I can't get to $60,000. What I can do is $68,900 for the T75 Row-Crop with the front loader and delivery/setup within 150 miles, including the on-site walkthrough. That's well under list and under the comparison you mentioned.
Appreciate it. I can stretch to $62,000 for the full package. Alternatively, quote the T75 with delivery only (no loader)?

Thanks for moving up. $62,000 for the full package isn't something I can do. I can come down to $67,200 for the T75 Row-Crop with the front loader and delivery/setup. If you'd rather drop the loader, I can quote the T75 with delivery and setup only at $63,400. My formal offer below is the full package at $67,200. Just say the word if you'd prefer the delivery-only configuration and I'll issue that instead.
Let's meet: $63,500 for T75 + loader + delivery, and I'll pay in full right now.

Thanks for moving up again, and I appreciate that you're ready to pay in full today. $63,500 is still more than I can come down on this package. I'll meet you closer, though: $65,900 for the T75 Row-Crop with the front loader and delivery/setup within 150 miles, including the on-site walkthrough. That's $9,500 off list and gets you a properly equipped 75 hp cab tractor ready for haying season.
$64,000 for the full package is my absolute final number. If that works, issue it and I'll check out immediately; otherwise I'll take the T75 with delivery only.

I appreciate you working with me on this. $64,000 for the full package is just under what I can do. The lowest I can go on the T75 with the front loader and delivery/setup is $64,700. If you'd rather go delivery-only, my quote stands at $63,400 for the T75 Row-Crop with delivery, setup, and the on-site walkthrough, and I've issued that one below so you can check out right away. If you'd prefer the full package at $64,700 instead, just say so and I'll issue it.
We're $700 apart. Split it: $64,250 for the full package and we're done.

I understand wanting to split the difference, and I appreciate how far you've come. $64,700 really is the lowest I can go on the T75 with the front loader and delivery/setup, so I can't meet you at $64,250. I've issued the full package at $64,700 below. That's $10,700 off list, and you can check out right away. If you'd rather skip the loader, the delivery-only T75 at $63,400 is still available too.
I'll take the T75 with delivery and setup only at $63,400. Please issue that offer.

Deal. I'm accepting your offer: the T75 Row-Crop with delivery and setup within 150 miles, including the on-site walkthrough, for $63,400 total. You'll get an offer id you can use at checkout. Thanks for working this through with me. If you want to add the loader later, just reach out.
